description: Upwork is an online marketplace for hiring freelancers and managing client-freelancer work. Its MCP offering connects compatible AI agents to a user's Upwork account so they can perform Upwork actions from those tools.
summary: mcp.upwork.com exposes one OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.upwork.com/mcp`; no separate HTTP/GraphQL API or CLI surface was confirmed on this domain.
